description: Replacing either child of an implication by an equivalent formula preserves the implication’s equivalence.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Theory.Iff.imp.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {T : L.Theory} {α : Type w} {n : ℕ}
  {φ ψ φ' ψ' : L.BoundedFormula α n} (h : T.Iff φ ψ) (h' : T.Iff φ' ψ') : T.Iff (φ.imp φ') (ψ.imp ψ')
